name: enter after all peers reply, deferring replies to lower-priority requests
mechanism: to enter a critical section broadcast a timestamped request and wait for a reply from every peer; a peer replies at once unless it is inside or wants in with an earlier timestamp, in which case it defers its reply until it leaves
